title: Make the decision yourself
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Where are you waiting for someone else's yes?

I said that, as a young man, the person in the book saw certain emerging-market bonds as undervalued. They were sold at a discount, he said, and backed by the US government. He took the idea to the bank, and the head of the bank said: this is insane.

Right away he is frustrated, I said. He learns: if I'm going to do something in my life, I want the power of making a decision and executing. I don't want to rely on something that doesn't see the opportunity.
I told my own story. In my twenties I thought: I don't want to deal with this boss, who has no idea of the opportunity we have. I wanted to go fast. I quit after eight months.
I read a line from the book and asked the class what they thought of it.
it was not in his nature to be deferential, or to assume that others might know more than he did.

There was a little bit of arrogance to him, I said. Obviously he's a genius, super smart, so he did not want other people to make decisions for him. He knows: look, I see this, they don't see it. That is a big characteristic of an entrepreneur.
You do not want to be slowed down by somebody who doesn't understand what they are looking at, I said. Entrepreneurs like to be first and to find value before anybody else does.
How do you value something, and how do you communicate that value?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write one place where you wait for someone else to decide.
Write the decision you would make if the power were yours.
Write how you would value the opportunity you see, and who needs to hear it.
Write what you would do if the person above you said: this is insane.
Write whether deferring or deciding fits you better, and why.

check.q: What did I say the person learned from the bank saying no?
choices: He wants the power to make a decision and execute

check.q: How long did I say I stayed with a boss in my twenties?
What did I say entrepreneurs like to do?
choices: Be first and find value before anybody else does

recap: Want the power to decide and execute. Learn to communicate the value you see.
